title: Hajj & Umrah
blurb: From ihram to the farewell tawaf

items.title: The Talbiyah
items.ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.tr: Labbayka-llahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-niʿmata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
items.en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Truly all praise, favour and dominion are Yours. You have no partner.
items.benefits: Said from entering ihram until the stoning of Jamrat al-ʿAqabah.

items.title: During tawaf, between the two corners
items.ar: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
items.en: But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

items.title: On climbing as-Safa
items.ar: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
items.en: Indeed as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.
items.benefits: Recited on approaching as-Safa to begin the saʿy.

items.title: Standing at as-Safa and al-Marwah
items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كَلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
items.tr: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ʿala kulli shay’in qadir. La ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza waʿdah, wa nasara ʿabdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. There is no god but Allah alone: He fulfilled His promise, aided His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.

items.title: The day of ʿArafah
items.en: The best supplication is the supplication of the Day of ʿArafah.
items.notes: The best of what was said by him ﷺ and the prophets before him is the words of tawhid above.
